newsitem.title: USA: Japan supports early China WTO accession - spokesman.
newsitem.headline: Japan supports early China WTO accession - spokesman.

text.p: Japan stands behind China in its campaign to join the World Trade Organization, a Japanese spokesman said.

Hiroshi Hashimoto, spokesman for the Japanese delegation at the Group of Seven summit here, said the fact China had become one of the more influential economic and political global powers supported its drive to join the WTO.

"Japan will continue to support China's reform and open policy and at the same time promote further cooperation between China and the international community through supporting China's early accession to the WTO and other means," Hashimoto said.
